info.title: Leave Management System API
info.description: User Management API (Auth, Employees, Departments) for the Leave Management System. Every endpoint returns `{ success, message, data }`. Users with `mustChangePassword = true` can only call `GET /api/v1/auth/me` and `POST /api/v1/auth/change-password`; all other authenticated routes return HTTP 403 with `code: "MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD"`.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Authentication, session refresh, password change, and OTP password reset

tags.name: Employees
tags.description: Employee lifecycle management (requires `employees.manage` permission; ADMIN bypasses)

tags.name: Departments
tags.description: Department management (`GET /departments` open to all authenticated users; write/single-get/delete require `employees.manage`)

bearerAuth.description: Enter the JWT accessToken returned by POST /api/v1/auth/login

newPassword.description: Minimum 8 characters with letters and numbers
Minimum 8 characters with letters and numbers

temporaryPassword.description: Minimum 8 characters with letters and numbers

employeeCode.description: Optional; auto-generated as EMP-0002, EMP-0003... if omitted

temporaryPassword.description: Minimum 8 characters with letters and numbers

message.example: You must change your temporary password before accessing other resources
Password must contain at least one letter and one number

post.summary: Authenticate user and return access & refresh tokens
post.description: Logs in an ACTIVE user with email and password. Updates last_login_at. Returns identical error messages for wrong email or wrong password.
Validates a refresh token and returns a fresh access token. Rejects INACTIVE users.

get.description: Returns the logged-in user's details along with employee profile and preferences. Accessible even when mustChangePassword is true.

post.description: Changes the password for the authenticated user and sets mustChangePassword to false. Accessible when mustChangePassword is true.
Generates and emails a 6-digit OTP (hashed in DB, 10-minute expiry). Always returns the same generic message regardless of whether the email exists.
Verifies the 6-digit OTP (single-use, max 5 wrong attempts, 10-minute expiry) and returns a short-lived resetToken.

400.description: Invalid, expired, used, or locked OTP code

post.description: Sets a new password for the user associated with the resetToken and clears mustChangePassword.
Creates user, employee, and user_preferences in a single transaction. Requires permission `employees.manage` (ADMIN bypasses). Sets mustChangePassword=true and auto-generates employeeCode if omitted.

400.description: Invalid reporting manager rule (e.g. ADMIN with manager, inactive/non-manager reporting manager)

404.description: Department or reporting manager not found

get.summary: List employees with search, filters, pagination, and sorting
get.description: Returns paginated employees with email, role, and status (never password_hash). Requires permission `employees.manage` (ADMIN bypasses).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name, email, or employeeCode

get.description: Fetches detailed employee profile without passwordHash. Requires permission `employees.manage` (ADMIN bypasses).

patch.summary: Update employee profile, department, manager, or role
patch.description: Updates employee details. Enforces self-manager prevention and ADMIN no-manager constraint. Requires permission `employees.manage` (ADMIN bypasses).

404.description: Employee, department, or manager not found

patch.summary: Activate or deactivate an employee account
patch.description: Sets user status to ACTIVE or INACTIVE. Administrators cannot deactivate themselves. Requires permission `employees.manage` (ADMIN bypasses).

post.summary: Admin reset of an employee's temporary password
post.description: Sets a new temporary password for the employee and forces mustChangePassword=true on next login. Requires permission `employees.manage` (ADMIN bypasses).

get.summary: List all departments with employee count
get.description: Accessible to any authenticated active user (no special permission required, useful for dropdowns). Blocked if mustChangePassword is true.

post.description: Creates a department under the organization. Requires permission `employees.manage` (ADMIN bypasses).

get.description: Fetches a department and its employee count. Requires permission `employees.manage` (ADMIN bypasses).

patch.description: Updates department name or description. Requires permission `employees.manage` (ADMIN bypasses).

delete.description: Deletes a department if it has zero assigned employees. Returns 409 Conflict if employees still belong to it. Requires permission `employees.manage` (ADMIN bypasses).
